author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Rebuild the phone dashboard around decisions and runs
purpose: Gives the phone dashboard one place for decisions, a complete flow for operator scripts, and a Runs page for work in progress and queued Actions.
serves: The Project outcome of fast, phone-first operator interaction, with decisions asked only when they are needed.
done_when: A decision opens on its own page with its options and consequences, and the Runs page leads with active work and keeps production control visible.

actions.title: Give each decision its own page
actions.why: Lets the operator read one decision with its options and consequences, and answer it there.
actions.done_when: A decision's page shows its question, each option with its consequence, the recommendation and the same answer controls, and answering there records the same result as the review list.

actions.title: Build a searchable library of operator scripts
actions.why: Makes each script easy to find, with its authority and next step visible before it runs.
actions.done_when: The scripts page can be searched and filtered by state, and each script page shows its full description, authority limits and current state, with a run or retry control.

actions.title: Put active work first on the Runs page
actions.why: Puts work in progress and production control where the operator looks first, with the next push one tap away.
actions.done_when: The Runs page leads with active sessions and runs, keeps production on or off visible, and loads the next push only when it is opened.
